content: Diya Menon inquired about the status of her auto policy renewal. Insurance agent Karan Joshi confirmed the policy is in 'Pending' status and stated that a confirmation email will be sent upon processing. Upon request, Karan provided the policy number (AP-001234) and attached the updated policy document. Diya acknowledged the information and agreed to wait for the confirmation email.

action_items: Karan Joshi to send confirmation email upon policy processing
